# Record and review activity attendance

## Problem

The application tracks signups but has no way for staff to record whether registered students attend sessions.

## Proposed outcome

Add an attendance workflow for authorized staff to take a roster for a group/session and record attendance.

## Acceptance criteria

- Authorized staff can view the roster for a group and mark each student present, absent, or another clearly defined status.
- Attendance records include the relevant activity/group and session date.
- Staff can correct a record, with changes persisted.
- Students and parents can see attendance information only for students they are authorized to view.
- Attendance records remain available for historical review.
- Access controls follow existing issue #5.
